title: Universal Yums Alternatives: 6 Global Snack Boxes - Cratejoy
summary: Looking for a Universal Yums alternative? Compare six snack boxes by price, size, and region, from Latin America and Mexico to vegan and vegetarian picks.
body_markdown:
## Questions before switching


Which alternative is closest to Universal Yums?


Pachanga Box. Like Universal Yums, it features one country per box and includes notes on each snack and the country. The difference is that every country is in Latin America, and each box holds 18 to 25 snacks.


Is there a cheaper snack box like Universal Yums?


MexiCrate’s Pequeña box costs $9.99 month to month for about 10 to 15 pieces of Mexican candy, about half the price of a $20 Yum Box. MexiCrate sticks to Mexico every month.


Is there a snack box like Universal Yums for special diets?


Universal Yums doesn’t customize boxes, and some of its items may contain gelatin or trace amounts of meat for flavoring. IndiFix is 100% vegetarian, and the Vegancuts Snack Box is entirely vegan. Neither is made for severe allergies, so check each listing’s ingredients.


Does Universal Yums ship to Canada?


Yes. Universal Yums ships to Canada for $5, $8, or $10 a box depending on size, and to US military addresses and territories. Shipping is free only in the contiguous US.


Can I send one of these as a gift?


The Cratejoy boxes on this list can be given as a gift from each listing page. Gift orders don’t renew. Universal Yums gifts are prepaid and can’t be cancelled.
